events.summary: iOS 26 Beta 1 (23A5260n) has 8 source-supported milestone deltas plus exact build and channel metadata.

blocks.text: Release identity
iOS 26 Beta 1 appeared on 2025-06-09. Its primary build is 23A5260n; that build identifier is scoped to iOS even when the same alphanumeric value also appeared on another Apple platform.
What changed at this milestone

This page records a representative initial developer-note inventory rather than treating every cumulative iOS and iPadOS 26 feature as a Beta 1 discovery. The selected entries cover the first seed’s Foundation Models, accessibility, HealthKit, journaling, Metal, StoreKit, and VPN-compatibility changes.
How to read these notes

Apple’s iOS and iPadOS 26 developer-notes page was updated throughout the beta cycle. This article uses preserved snapshots to isolate what the retained evidence supports at Beta 1; it does not project the final public notes backward or describe an unlisted revision as a bug or security fix.
